container.location: 48-byte trailer after the existing length-delimited STATE lens name

semantics.quaternion_convention: Hamilton, body to arbitrary reference initialized once at boot
semantics.invalid_quaternion_lanes: ignored; zero or retained values allowed
semantics.capture_reference: same fixed reference as current quaternion
semantics.capture_retention: until next capture latch or boot; reads, solves, and acquisition pauses retain it
semantics.capture_sequence_scope: boot; increments only when a new capture is latched
semantics.capture_timestamp: CPU0 gyro tick; preparation flag excludes an exact exposure-start claim
semantics.capture_to_solve_association: consumer checks exactly one new latch against pre-capture baseline
semantics.absolute_attitude: not present; app supplies horizon alignment from a plate solve
semantics.continuity: acquisition pauses retain orientation; unobserved motion during a pause contributes error; connection replacement invalidates app alignment
